description: Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11: makes command blocks react to EcoBal money. /ecotry take, give and has really fail when a player can't pay, so execute store success and conditional chain blocks work.

mods.name: EcoTry
mods.description: Bridge between EcoBal and command blocks: /ecotry take|give|has really fail when there is not enough money, so 'execute store success' and conditional chain command blocks can branch on it. /ecotry balance returns the balance as the command result.

releases.notes:
First release of EcoTry for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).

### Features
- `/ecotry take|give|has <players> <amount> [notify|silent]`: real command failures for command blocks, functions and
  `execute store`.
- `/ecotry balance <player>`: the balance (rounded down) as the command result.
- Several targets: every player is handled on their own; the result is the number of players it worked for.
- Optional player messages in the chat or the action bar, with `&` color codes and placeholders.
- English and German texts; the server language is a setting, unchanged messages follow it.
- In-game settings screen via Mod Menu (optional), `config/ecotry.json` and `/ecotry reload`.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [EcoBal](https://modrinth.com/mod/ecobal) 1.0.1 or newer (it needs [fabric-permissions-api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-permissions-api))
- Optional: [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for the in-game settings screen

Install it on the server. For singleplayer, put it into your own `mods` folder. Players don't need it.

### Files
- `ecotry-1.0.0.jar` – the mod
- `ecotry-1.0.0-sources.jar` – source code
